cameras.note: nominal: each run's camera units differ (cell_manual.md, Cameras)

damage.note: a loose unit pressed on the environment or on another unit with a contact force above part_force_N for `ticks` consecutive control ticks zeroes the episode; the force of a (unit, body it presses on) pair is the magnitude of the vector sum of that pair's contact forces; the gripper's pads, the robot's links and the force with which the cell holds or fastens a captured unit do not count (cell_manual.md, Safety)

fixture.note: the turnover positioner: at most max_turns turns per run, turn_s per turn; the load cells: white noise sigma_N per sample and cell, a zero offset of up to bias_N per cell that is constant through a run

handling.note: the station's handling procedure for a unit in the gripper; the cell does not enforce it

note: the cell's configuration as far as it is public; not public: the cameras' exact mounts and their per-run spreads, the lights, the layout's draws

safety.note: robot_force_N: a robot link other than the gripper's pads pressing on one body harder than this zeroes the episode (the normal forces of that link's contacts with that body added up); part_speed_m_s: a loose unit faster than this is scrapped; dome_force_N for dome_ticks ticks on the enclosure's dome scraps the enclosure

score.note: stage = (the weights of the places that count + trim_weight x trim) / total_weight; trim = share_net_buoyancy [net buoyancy in its window] + share_pitch [and |pitch| <= the angle] + share_roll [and |roll| <= the angle]

scrap.note: a loose unit whose centre of mass is more than below_bench_m below the bench top is scrapped
